policy: Exactly one formal rainwater-leader implementation may own the benchmark-facing assembly. The existing RainGutter macro body plus HD_RainwaterDownpipeAssembly accessories remain authoritative because they are already reconstructed, dimensioned, material-reasoned, LOD-integrated and explicitly invoked by the native-4K preparation path. A second independently positioned replacement system is prohibited.

forbiddenDuplicateSystem.reason: Those files described a second leader at unrelated installation coordinates and disabled the benchmark's existing RainGutter authority. Keeping both systems would make construction provenance ambiguous and could create duplicate geometry, contradictory LOD/material state, or formal-render failure.

evidenceBinding.rationale: The rendered rainwater geometry is not scoreable against construction metadata unless both the detailed installation contract and the single-authority policy are members of the same SHA-256-bound construction/material source bundle as the persisted benchmark scene and render receipt.

failureInjection: create a second active RainGutter renderer
delete the authoritative rainwater installation contract
mutate either bound rainwater contract after sealing a render receipt and attempt to reuse the old 4K pixels
remove the authoritative ApplyAndPersist call from the native-4K packet
reduce native-4K rainwater validation calls below the contract minimum
reintroduce either forbidden duplicate source file
claim Visual Fidelity credit from this source-only authority gate
